summary: The diff implements most of the 12 requirements but has several gaps. REQ-7 (ETH gas price / DefiLlama TVL) is partially missing, REQ-11 (animation audit across all listed pages) is only superficially addressed via SmokySectionTransition usage without a dedicated audit/fix of IntersectionObserver/parallax/reduced-motion, REQ-12 requires migration.mo which is absent from the diff, and the backend main.mo is truncated so full verification of all CRUD methods and stable-state declarations is uncertain.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fetch ETH gas price (from Etherscan public API or fallback) and top DeFi TVL estimate from CoinGecko public endpoints for the Insights page
missing_requirements.reason: The useRealWorldAnalytics hook only fetches from CoinGecko /global endpoint. There is no ETH gas price fetch (Etherscan or fallback) and no DeFi TVL fetch in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Audit and fix all page-level animations: SmokySectionTransition, parallax hooks, IntersectionObserver callbacks, CSS keyframe animations, and reduced-motion preference across AcquisitionPage, AlertsCenterPage, AdvancedAnalyticsPage, MarketIntelPage, MarketPulsePage, InsightsPage, CommunityVotingPage, AISentimentPage, LivePricePage
missing_requirements.reason: Pages wrap content in SmokySectionTransition but there is no evidence of a dedicated animation audit, parallax hook fixes, IntersectionObserver callback repairs, or reduced-motion media query handling being added or fixed. No animation utility files were modified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Generate migration.mo to safely upgrade existing canister state without data loss
missing_requirements.reason: No migration.mo file appears in the diff (neither added nor modified). This is an explicit acceptance criterion.

hallucinated_features.description: AcquisitionPage auto-submits pending sessionStorage form data to WhatsApp when the timer unlocks on mount
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-9 requires WhatsApp redirect on manual form submit after unlock, not automatic submission of previously saved sessionStorage data on timer unlock. The auto-submit behavior using sessionStorage was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: CommunityVotingPage enforces a hardcoded MARKET_INTEL_PASSCODE to create polls
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-10 does not mention any passcode requirement for poll creation. This gate was not requested.
